redTeamMethodology.startingPremise: Assume all Phase 1 capabilities are NOT PROVEN until independent adversarial attacks fail to find a counterexample
rulesFollowed: Production code modified only upon discovery of genuine engineering defects
Decoupled independent mathematical reference used for all comparisons

defectsDiscoveredAndRemediated.description: Validator used boundaryEdges > 0 and nonManifoldEdges > 0 on string[] arrays, which evaluated to false in JS due to NaN comparison, missing actual boundary edge corruptions.
defectsDiscoveredAndRemediated.remediation: Updated to boundaryEdges.length > 0 and nonManifoldEdges.length > 0, ensuring 100% detection of open manifold holes.
defectsDiscoveredAndRemediated.verifiedBy: BRepPhase1RedTeam.test.ts (A7 Mutation 8 and A8 False-Positive check)

defectsDiscoveredAndRemediated.description: Fillet operation lacked upper bound validation against target edge length, permitting non-physical blend radii exceeding edge boundaries.
defectsDiscoveredAndRemediated.remediation: Added strict geometric edge length threshold check: radius >= edgeLength triggers safe diagnostic rejection.

defectsDiscoveredAndRemediated.description: Near polar regions (|phi| > 45 deg), altitude computation p/cos(phi) - N suffered precision degradation due to near-zero divisor; solver also lacked polar singularity branch and deep iteration for GEO altitudes.
defectsDiscoveredAndRemediated.remediation: Implemented dual-regime altitude computation (using z/sin(phi) at high latitudes), explicit polar singularity branch (p < 1e-12), and 15-iteration Bowring-Newton solver converging to < 1e-16 rad.
